title: Prevent the three closeout reports from requesting another product release

hourly_workflow_entry.behavior: The independent dev-pair job checks out ref: dev and runs `python3 scripts/auto_deploy_dev_pair.py --fe-url "$DEV_FE_URL" --bff-url "$DEV_BFF_URL" --apply` on every hourly tick regardless of steps.check.outputs.should_cut.

branch_ci_entry.behavior: Runs Branch CI Gate on every push to dev, producing the completed push workflow run queried by ci_passed().

pre_fix_inspector_behavior.behavior: inspect_pair() read both protected dev tips (backend.get_ref('dev'), frontend.get_ref('dev')) and compared only exact SHA equality against manifest/BFF/releaseAdmission before checking failed_pair_run() and ci_passed(). Merging a PR that modified only the three closeout report paths advanced dev past the served BFF SHA and, after push CI succeeded, caused the next hourly dev-pair tick to return state='ready' and dispatch nonprod-deploy.yml (component=root). This is a conditional feedback path when closeout reports are merged after an accepted Root release, not an autonomous report writer or proven multi-Root loop.

implemented_boundary_and_honest_limits.closeout_reports_only_helper: closeout_reports_only(backend, base_sha, head_sha) queries GET /repos/{backend.repository}/compare/{base_sha}...{head_sha} via the existing GitHubClient and returns True only when status == 'ahead', behind_by == 0, ahead_by == total_commits > 0, commits (if present) is un-truncated, files is a non-empty un-truncated list (1 <= len(files) < 300 and total_files in (None, len(files))), and every file entry has status in {'added', 'modified', 'removed', 'renamed'}, filename in CLOSEOUT_REPORT_PATHS, and any previous_filename (mandatory when status == 'renamed') also in CLOSEOUT_REPORT_PATHS.
implemented_boundary_and_honest_limits.inspect_pair_behavior: After verifying accepted baseline, persistent profile ('read-only' or 'operator-live'), and strict live auth/write posture, inspect_pair() requires full served identity coherence (manifest.bffCommit == version.source_commit_sha == manifest.releaseAdmission.backend.commitSha == served_backend and manifest.frontendSha == manifest.releaseAdmission.frontend.commitSha == frontend_sha). When served_backend != backend_sha and closeout_reports_only(backend, served_backend, backend_sha) holds, inspect_pair() returns {'backend_sha': backend_sha, 'frontend_sha': frontend_sha, 'frontend_profile': profile, 'served_backend_sha': served_backend, 'state': 'report_only_no_deploy'}. reconcile(..., apply=True) returns this result without dispatching nonprod-deploy.yml and never relabels the unserved dev tip as 'up_to_date'.
